title: Rene's congregation and a trip to Kansas City
summary: Zander asks whether the church ties in with clubs; Rene says they do not parade, then talks about visiting Kansas City.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Is there any club which ties in with this church in any way? I've never seen them buried with music from this church.

Well, no, we don't. We don't participate in no parades at all. You see, all we buried, that's why I don't want to have a service here. It's free here. See, we're all preaching is free. When they want to get married, married to Samuel, it's free. We don't charge. It's free. It's free. So many free things we do. I just come from Kansas City, Missouri. You know who I was trying to get when he was out of town? Count Bay. That's his own town, you know? Mm-hmm. Count Bay. Oh, the summer of the... You ever been to Kansas City, Missouri? No, I never have. If you ever go there, you want all... You want all... You want all to leave from there. You know they got some of the finest people on there I'm going to see. They're this. That hospitality, man, is great. Them people is wonderful over there. They're nice. Why they come?
They're all the same. They're just a nice.

They come to the house trust where they do. They go and leave your house and leave them with you. Me and the fellas stopped there. We had the whole house. They said, all right, man. We're going, you know? And everybody got two, three armobiles in the family. They're doing pretty good up there. They're like... Beautiful park in Kansas City. At Kansas City Stadium. Because that's all we use is parks, you know? I'm expecting to go back to New York. If I can get the money, I'm going to go back to Yankee Stadium. I'm going to go to Dallas. I don't know where this congregation is going to go at. Wherever they go, I'm going to have to follow you. Because always the majority is going to go. That's where we go at. Because I want to stop at Red Island, you know? And when we get up there and get a clinic with some of the boys. Some of the new boys and some of the old boys. And he told me he wanted to bring me around. Show them a couple of things.
